Description: Centralized session-based authentication engine using cryptographic salted hashing (PBKDF2 sha512).
Backend Requirement: Verify session tokens, manage expiration timestamps, issue Bearer tokens
Database Requirement: sessions collection with token, userId, expiresAt, rememberMe
Security Requirement: Constant-time password verification (crypto.timingSafeEqual), no plain text passwords stored
UI Requirement: Dark glassmorphism modal & full-screen layouts, responsive mobile views

Description: Dedicated login gateway with credential verification, Remember Me support, and password visibility toggle.
Validation: Required email, valid email format regex, required password
Backend Requirement: Authenticate user against salt & hash, issue session token (24h or 30d if rememberMe)
Database Requirement: Look up users record by email; append session to sessions
Security Requirement: Generic error 'Invalid email or password.' to prevent account enumeration, rate-limiting ready
UI Requirement: Split-screen branding on desktop, Lucide eye toggle, accessible labels, soft red glow

Description: Multi-attribute student sign-up capturing personal, academic, and learning language preferences with direct session activation.
Inputs: name, email, password, confirmPassword, college, course, branch, year, semester, preferredLanguage, examDate
Validation: Min 8 chars, 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase, 1 number; password confirmation match; required fields
Backend Requirement: Check email uniqueness (409 Conflict), hash password with random 16-byte salt, establish authenticated session immediately
Database Requirement: Insert into users collection with initial level 1, 50 XP, streak 1, emailVerified: true, and academic metadata
Security Requirement: Sanitize outputs (omit password hashes, salts, and tokens in response)
UI Requirement: Real-time 3-stage password strength meter (Weak/Medium/Strong), direct dashboard entry (no OTP required)

Description: Strict client & server-side password entropy enforcement with visual feedback.
Validation: Length >= 8, at least 1 uppercase, at least 1 lowercase, at least 1 numeric character
Backend Requirement: Server-side validatePassword() check rejecting weak passwords with HTTP 400
Database Requirement: Store passwordHash and passwordSalt; never store plaintext passwords
Security Requirement: Passwords hashed using PBKDF2 with 10,000 iterations and 64-byte key length
UI Requirement: Live visual strength progress bar and rule checkmarks; eye show/hide icon

Description: Official Google Sign-In using Google Identity Services (GIS) and token exchange.
Inputs: Google JWT Credential or verified profile payload
Validation: Valid Google JWT structure, verified email payload
Backend Requirement: Parse Google token payload safely, locate existing account or create new Syllora AI profile
Database Requirement: Link googleId to user record; initialize default streak and XP; flag onboarding if incomplete
Security Requirement: Never store Google passwords; accept only cryptographically signed tokens
UI Requirement: Official Google colored logo button, 'Connecting to Google...' loading feedback

Description: Direct account verification architecture eliminating email delivery OTP bottlenecks.
Backend Requirement: Account marked emailVerified: true at creation; auto-heals legacy accounts; direct dashboard routing
Database Requirement: Direct access flag on user; legacy unverified accounts auto-verified on login/session check
Security Requirement: Prevent unverified state lockouts while preserving strict user ownership and password security
UI Requirement: Instant dashboard transition, direct status banner on /verify-email

Description: Non-enumerating password recovery workflow with 15-minute token expiration.

Database Requirement: Store resetToken and resetExpiresAt on matching user document
Security Requirement: Uniform response message regardless of email existence to prevent user enumeration
UI Requirement: Friendly confirmation panel; workspace simulation token for developer testing

Description: Password replacement gateway validating reset tokens and updating credentials.
Validation: Token validity, token not expired, new password matches complexity rules, passwords match
Backend Requirement: Validate resetExpiresAt > Date.now(), re-hash new password, invalidate reset token
Database Requirement: Update passwordHash and passwordSalt; remove resetToken and resetExpiresAt
Security Requirement: Invalidate all prior sessions on password reset for complete account security
UI Requirement: Password complexity checklist, eye toggle, success confirmation with redirect

Description: Persistent multi-device session engine with token restoration upon browser reload.

Database Requirement: sessions table tracks token, userId, createdAt, expiresAt, rememberMe
Security Requirement: Tokens generated via crypto.randomBytes(32); local storage token purged on logout/401
UI Requirement: 'Restoring your session...' loading transition on page refresh

Description: Route-level authentication guard preventing unauthorized access to study resources.

Backend Requirement: Middleware getSessionUser returns 401 if unauthenticated; blocks access
Database Requirement: Scope all queries to authenticated user ID
Security Requirement: Unauthenticated requests redirected to /login; intended route preserved for post-login redirect
UI Requirement: Clean redirect handling with toast alert; no flash of unauthorized content
